svg.aria-label: A usage-map table of 33 cells, one per category of work, each with a short column as tall as that work is dense (illustrative). Two glass planes stand over the map at index 46, MiMo-V2.6-Pro, the leading open-weight model, and index 58, the metered frontier. Every routine column sits under the 46 plane. A gantry press pulls tall spikes, shipped frontier-lab products, up through both planes out of the densest cells in launch order: image gen 2022, software 2024–25, security 2025, finance and CFO 2025–26, legal 2026. A sixth dense cell is dashed in red: yours?
